COD.rationale: Content, origin/organization and a separate status/distinction are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: Multiple lines identify specific content attributes (red/blue) with coordinate sets for named referents and current time.

D.rationale: The report separately records identified content (coordinates) and its origin/status for the same referent/time, distinguishing content from organizational/status information.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization fields describe how entries are presented or derived (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) for named referents and times.
